posts.title: How docker can break your ufw rules
posts.description: TLDR: Docker can break your ufw rules if you are not careful. And you might not even notice it until it is too late. I was in shock recently when I tested my personal servers ip-address for open ports with nmap -sV -p- <your-server-ip> . I had 5 open ports but it should have only been 3. I ssh'ed into my server to check the firewall rules with sudo ufw status and it looked like everything was fine
